
---
title: "DT-GFN: Bayesian Decision Trees with GFlowNets"
---

Welcome to my tutorial and research website.

This project explores how **Generative Flow Networks
(GFlowNets)** can be used to sample Bayesian decision
tree structures.

## What you'll find here

### Theory
Mathematical foundations of Bayesian decision trees,
GFlowNets, and trajectory balance.

### Tutorials
Step-by-step computational examples demonstrating
tree construction, posterior sampling, and training.

### Research
Experiments on posterior accuracy, uncertainty
quantification, and categorical splitting strategies.

## The central idea

We want to sample decision trees according to:

$$
p(T \mid D) \propto p(D \mid T)p(T)
$$

DT-GFN trains a GFlowNet to approximate this
distribution through sequential tree construction.
